rawContent: If you’ve been to a #BlackLivesMatter rally or protest in Minneapolis, you’ve probably heard or sung Jayanthi Kyle’s amazing “Day’s Gonna Come When I Don’t March No More.” If that song touched you, give a little to help her family. ✊🏻
For a gathering like this to be targeted for murder by a violent racist extremist is sickening. He is a terrorist, pure and simple. #DeonaMarie #BlackLivesMatter
